early_break.default: Softer — stay on the low one.
early_break.high_d: Softer — the low whistle wants slower air than the small one.

restarted_notes.wind: You restarted every note. Start once, and let the rest join.

still_d.default: That’s still D — the bottom finger is down.

couldnt_hear.default: Couldn’t hear. Come a little closer to the mic and play it again.

cut_too_long.default: That cut turned into its own note.

headphones.default: Use headphones so the app doesn’t hear itself.

cracked.default: That fell back to the low one.
